{{Quote|Oh, no! He has taken it to another world.''"<br />"''Yes, of course. He thinks you can't follow, yes.''"<br />"''But he's right! I can't!''"<br />"''But you can, come. Come with me, yes.|Boba Fett and Aia, after the ''Slave I'' was stolen|<ref name="TFTS" />}}
A '''mission''' was undertaken by the young [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] to regain possession of his [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|starship]] [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. The [[Starship/Legends|ship]] had been stolen by the [[H'drachi]] [[Gjon]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of [[Bogden/Legends|Bogden]] after Fett had paid Gjon to fix a strut on the ''Slave I'' that had been damaged when the he landed on the moon [[Bogg 4]]. Finding the starship stolen when he returned to the H'drachi's [[Honest Gjon Starship Service|shop]], Fett was only able to pursue Gjon with the help of the [[Bird/Legends|birdlike]] [[Aia]], who knew where Gjon was and flew the young [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter from Bogg 4 to another moon, [[Bogg 11]], where the ''Slave I'' was being held. Fett then confronted Gjon, who let him have his ship back.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|How much to fix a strut?''"<br />"''How much you got?|Boba Fett and Gjon, after the former damaged his ship|<ref name="TFTS" />}}
In the wake of the [[Death/Legends|death]] of his [[Jango Fett/Legends|father]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|onset]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the young [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] traveled to the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of [[Bogden/Legends|Bogden]] in search of the man called [[Dooku/Legends|Tyranus]]. Fett sought Tyranus because he had hired Fett's [[Parent/Legends|father]] to be the [[Clone template/Legends|prime clone]] for the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the new [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], and Fett needed his help to access the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] Jango had set away for his son. Landing on the moon [[Bogg 4]], Fett damaged a strut on his [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|starship]], [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']], as he landed on a pad outside of [[Honest Gjon Starship Service]], a shop owned by the [[H'drachi]] [[Gjon]]. Fett paid Gjon to fix the strut and went into [[Unidentified town (Bogg 4)|town]] to search for Tyranus. With Fett gone and knowing the access codes after they were given to him by the young [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter to repair the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], Gjon piloted ''Slave I'' to another one of Bogden's moons, [[Bogg 11]], to scrap the ship for spare parts.<ref name="TFTS" />

==The mission==
{{Quote|The gravity waves rise and fall with the moons, yes. If you get high enough, and if you know what you are doing, you can ride them. Like a bird on the wind, yes.|Aia, describing how he and Boba Fett will get to Bogg 11|<ref name="TFTS" />}}
Boba Fett soon returned from the [[City/Legends|town]], where he had gone to the local [[Cantina/Legends|tavern]] [[The Bonny Bounty]] in an attempt to find any information about the whereabouts of Tyranus. Discovering ''Slave I'' gone, Fett despaired until the [[Bird/Legends|birdlike]] [[Aia]], whom he had met on his way to town, showed him the moon where Gjon had taken ''Slave I'', visible from where they were. Aia led Jango's son to a cliff near the landing pad, and explained that due to the many moons in close proximity to each other around Bogden, [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] waves rose and fell according to the moons, allowing one to fly using them. Aia took Fett's [[Limb/Legends|hand]] and stepped off the cliff, proceeding to fly Fett from Bogg 4 to Bogg 11, briefly passing through [[Realspace/Legends|space]] before entering the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of Bogg 11. They circled down to the surface, allowing the young bounty hunter to see ''Slave I'' in a small valley. Fett confronted Gjon, who gave him back the ship as he had not gotten to work on it, though the strut damaged during the landing had been fixed.<ref name="TFTS" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I happen to know of some money being smuggled from Bogg 2 to Bogg 9. A few fellows with a good ship and a little luck could take what they needed.|Gjon, telling Fett and Aia of a potential opportunity|<ref name="TFTS" />}}
Low on money but with a fully repaired ''Slave I'', Boba Fett decided to help Aia and Gjon [[Firefight on Bogden's moons|intercept]] [[light-air balloon]]s carrying counterfeit credits from [[Bogg 2]] as the balloons traveled to [[Bogg 9]].<ref name="TFTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mission to Bogg 11 first appeared in the [[2002]] novel ''[[Boba Fett: The Fight to Survive]]'', written by [[Terry Bisson]].<ref name="TFTS" />
